# Real-pose fixtures

BlazePose GHUM 3D outputs (world landmarks, visibility and presence logits) recorded from openly licensed footage. They contain numbers only, no video.

| File | Source | License |
|------|--------|---------|
| `cleave_pose.json` | "Wood cleaving - 2016.webm", Wikimedia Commons | CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| `standing_block_pose.json` | "Wood chopping competition (standing block cut).webm", Wikimedia Commons, cropped to one athlete, 5–17 s | CC BY-SA 3.0 |

The values are derived from those works and shared under the same licenses.
